primary_interest.quote: We want a voice AI support agent for patients and for our clinic staff.

use_case.quote: We want a voice AI support agent for patients and for our clinic staff.

edge_framing.quote: You could buy it on its own through the API. It doesn't depend on our voice agents at all.

decision_criteria.quote: the two things I care about most are how much integration effort this is and how fast we can get to production. And the second is latency.

stated_reason.quote: for anything in the live call path, I'd want a p95 around 80 milliseconds, and cold starts on Lambda make that harder than I'd like.
